actions.name: get_outline
actions.title: Get document outline
actions.description: Return the document structure as a nested tree of sections, toggles and headings (id, type, title, level, children) with the title and revision. The cheapest way to learn the layout before reading or editing. Read-only.

maxDepth.description: Trim the tree below this depth.

actions.name: find_blocks
actions.title: Find blocks
actions.description: Search blocks by type, text, parent, container, citation or ID. Returns compact summaries (id, type, version, parentId, text preview) in document order; the version is what update, move and delete calls need. Use include "content" for full blocks. Read-only. At most 200 results per call (default 50); page with offset.

type.description: One block type or a list of types: section, heading, paragraph, list, table, chart, embed, timestamp, quote, callout, code, divider, image, toggle, metrics, toc, pageBreak.

text.description: Case-insensitive text the block must contain.

parentId.description: Only direct children of this block; null for top-level blocks.

within.description: Only descendants (any depth) of this section or toggle.

items.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

citationId.description: Only blocks that cite this citation.

actions.name: get_block
actions.title: Get block
actions.description: Return one block in full (content, version, parent, citations) with its ancestors and the IDs of its children. Read the version here before updating, moving or deleting the block. Read-only.

blockId.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

actions.name: document_stats
actions.title: Document statistics
actions.description: Word and character counts, reading time (minutes), block counts by type and the number of charts, tables, images and citations. Read-only.

actions.name: export_markdown
actions.title: Export markdown
actions.description: Export the document (or one section) as Markdown (charts become data tables, callouts GitHub alerts, citations footnotes). Read-only. Returns { text, format, characters }.

blockId.description: Export only this block and its descendants.

actions.name: export_html
actions.title: Export HTML
actions.description: Export the document (or one section) as escaped static HTML (no scripts, iframes or raw HTML pass-through). Read-only. Returns { text, format, characters }.

blockId.description: Export only this block and its descendants.

standalone.description: Return a complete page with a small stylesheet instead of an <article> fragment.

actions.name: export_text
actions.title: Export plain text
actions.description: Export the document (or one section) as plain text. Read-only. Returns { text, format, characters }.

blockId.description: Export only this block and its descendants.

actions.name: list_revisions
actions.title: List revisions
actions.description: List recent revisions of this editing session, newest first: number, time, actor, kind and a one-line summary. History is session-scoped unless the host keeps durable revisions. Read-only.

actions.name: list_templates
actions.title: List report templates
actions.description: List the report templates (equity, macro, portfolio, strategy, arbitrage, comparison, blank) with their section titles. Use insert_template to add one. Read-only.

actions.name: validate_transaction
actions.title: Validate a transaction
actions.description: Check a Core transaction (the same object apply_transaction takes) without saving it: structure, guards and the resulting document are all validated. Returns what would change, or the issues. Read-only.

transaction.description: A transaction: { id, actor, baseRevision, operations[] }.

actions.name: insert_blocks
actions.title: Insert blocks
actions.description: Insert new blocks, all or none. Send markdown (headings, paragraphs with **bold**, _italic_, `code` and [links](https://...), lists, tables, quotes, code fences, dividers) or an array of blocks. Position with afterId and parentId; the default is the end of the document. Returns the new block IDs and versions. Content shapes: paragraph{runs:[{text,bold?,italic?,code?,href?,strike?,underline?,highlight?,citationId?}]}, heading{level:1-3,text}, list{ordered,items:[text],style?:bullet|number|todo,checked?:[bool],indent?:[0-3]}, table{columns:[text],rows:[[text]],align?,caption?}, quote{runs,attribution?}, callout{tone:info|success|warning|danger|note,title?,runs}, code{language,text}, image{url(https),alt,caption?}, metrics{items:[{label,value,change?,tone?}]}, chart{spec}, embed{provider:"superchart",url(https),title}, section{title}, toggle{title,open}, divider, toc, pageBreak. Full schema: the transaction schema.

markdown.description: Markdown to convert into blocks. Use this or blocks.

id.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

parentId.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

content.description: Block content, for example {"type":"paragraph","runs":[{"text":"Hello"}]}. Shapes are listed in the tool description.

items.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

blocks.description: Ready-made blocks, parents before children. Use this or markdown.

afterId.description: Insert after this sibling block ID. null inserts first; omit to append at the end of the parent.

parentId.description: Container (section or toggle) for markdown blocks; null for the document root. Blocks you send carry their own parentId.

idPrefix.description: Markdown only: prefix for the generated block IDs. Default: a fresh unique prefix.

transactionId.description: Idempotency key for safe retries: the identical call (same expectedRevision) returns the first result.

expectedRevision.description: Conflict unless the document is at this revision.

actions.name: update_block_text
actions.title: Replace a block's text
actions.description: Replace all text in one block. Works on paragraph, heading, quote, callout, code, list (one item per line), section and toggle. Paragraph, quote and callout text is inline markdown (**bold**, _italic_, `code`, [link](https://...)) unless format is "plain"; other formatting in the block is replaced. Requires the version you last read. To change a phrase and keep the rest, use replace_text.

blockId.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

expectedVersion.description: The block version you last read (from get_block or find_blocks).

format.description: markdown (default) parses inline marks; plain keeps the text literally.

conflictPolicy.description: Default "reject". "rebase-safe" applies the edit when the document moved on but this block did not change.

transactionId.description: Idempotency key for safe retries: the identical call (same expectedRevision) returns the first result.

expectedRevision.description: Conflict unless the document is at this revision.

actions.name: update_block
actions.title: Replace a block's content
actions.description: Replace the whole content of one block (for example a table, list, chart or callout) keeping its ID and place. The block type may change within the same parent rules. Requires the version you last read. Content shapes: paragraph{runs:[{text,bold?,italic?,code?,href?,strike?,underline?,highlight?,citationId?}]}, heading{level:1-3,text}, list{ordered,items:[text],style?:bullet|number|todo,checked?:[bool],indent?:[0-3]}, table{columns:[text],rows:[[text]],align?,caption?}, quote{runs,attribution?}, callout{tone:info|success|warning|danger|note,title?,runs}, code{language,text}, image{url(https),alt,caption?}, metrics{items:[{label,value,change?,tone?}]}, chart{spec}, embed{provider:"superchart",url(https),title}, section{title}, toggle{title,open}, divider, toc, pageBreak. Full schema: the transaction schema.

expectedVersion.description: The block version you last read (from get_block or find_blocks).

content.description: Block content, for example {"type":"paragraph","runs":[{"text":"Hello"}]}. Shapes are listed in the tool description.

citationIds.description: Replace the block-level citations. Omit to keep them.

actions.name: replace_text
actions.title: Replace text
actions.description: Find and replace text while keeping formatting (matches may span inline runs; the replacement takes the formatting where the match starts). With blockId it edits one block and needs the version you last read. Without blockId it edits every block that contains the text, using the current versions, optionally limited to a container with within. Case-insensitive unless caseSensitive. Replaces every occurrence unless all is false. Fails with not-found when nothing matches.

replace.description: May be empty to delete the text.

within.description: Without blockId: only blocks inside this container.

expectedRevision.description: Conflict unless the document is at this revision.

actions.name: move_blocks
actions.title: Move blocks
actions.description: Move one or more blocks (with their children) under a parent, in the order given. parentId is required: a section or toggle ID, or null for the document root. Position with afterId (a sibling in the destination; null for first; omit for last). Each block needs the version you last read.

expectedVersion.description: The block version you last read (from get_block or find_blocks).

actions.title: Delete blocks
actions.description: Delete blocks. Deleting a section or toggle also deletes everything inside it. Each block needs the version you last read. Deleted IDs stay reserved and cannot be reused. Undo is available in the same session.

actions.name: add_chart
actions.title: Add a chart
actions.description: Insert a chart block. spec needs kind, title, labels and series (one value per label). Kinds: pie, donut, bar, trend, line, area, scatter, histogram, candlestick, heatmap, waterfall. scatter also needs points, candlestick needs ohlc, heatmap needs matrix (labels and series stay as the data-table fallback). Optional: unit, asOf, stacked, horizontal, yAxis, xLabel, caption, source, annotations. Put the data source in spec.source. Returns the new block ID.

afterId.description: Insert after this sibling block ID. null inserts first; omit to append at the end of the parent.

parentId.description: Container for the chart; null for the document root.

id.description: Optional ID for the new block. Default: chart-N.

items.description: Letters, digits and . _ : - ; starts with a letter or digit.

citationIds.description: Citations that support this chart (they must exist).

transactionId.description: Idempotency key for safe retries: the identical call (same expectedRevision) returns the first result.

expectedRevision.description: Conflict unless the document is at this revision.

kind.description: Known kinds: pie, donut, bar, trend, line, area, scatter, histogram, candlestick, heatmap, waterfall. Other kinds stay valid and render a data table. Every kind needs labels and series; scatter, candlestick and heatmap also need points, ohlc or matrix, with labels/series as the fallback table.

color.description: Hex color, CSS color keyword or var(--token).
